cc:Work.dc:description: Only the three source-selected Akins/enstatite/melt shock states enter this diagnostic. Curves use each recorded initial density and the audit's fixed Mie–Grüneisen/transition-energy reduction. They are theoretical Hugoniots, not the catalog's reference isentrope fitted directly to shock states. Pressure residuals use the source shock pressures. The bounded, ill-conditioned reconstruction and its original qualifications remain applicable.
